description: Returns one curated weekly Reality Check edition: for Strategy (MSTR), Strive (ASST), and Metaplanet (3350), over 1 week, 1 month, 3 months, 6 months, and 12 months, three separate readings: the equity's unlevered performance relative to BTC, the financed deployment result against holding the original 1 BTC after the documented repurchase economics (break-even needs a 1 BTC terminal value), and coverage of the 0.95 BTC repurchase obligation with any shortfall. Prices are sourced adjusted closes in the edition record; Metaplanet is converted from JPY with the recorded USD/JPY rate. Historical, hypothetical, and retrospective only: not a forecast, a recommendation, or evidence of available contract maturities. Shorter windows are hypothetical holding periods.
name: read_reality_check
